brief: A cabinet of three cells with two drawers, one of them shown pulled open.

drawer:0#-1,0#cut and drawer:0#1,0#cut, one on the open side of each half base.
setDrawerOpen on (1,0) went through without a refusal, and the drawer at (-1,0) stays closed. get_build does not list open state and look did not confirm it, so this rests on the accepted op.

finish.summary: A three-cell cabinet in one row: a full base in the middle and a north-half base on each side. Each half base holds a drawer, and the drawer at (1,0) is set open. Open edges are capped with solid caps and the joints are bolted. check_build reports no rule errors and the collision check is clear. One edge of the middle cell is left uncapped because a cap would hit the drawer frame. The open drawer was set without a refusal, but get_build does not record open state and look did not confirm it.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
